name: kindrd
description: A private, self-hostable family tree with a portable offline viewer.

scripts.test: node scripts/build.mjs --example && node --test viewer.test.cjs cloudflare/worker.test.mjs scripts/build.test.mjs
scripts.dev: npm run build && npm run db:local && wrangler dev --config wrangler.example.jsonc --port 8788 --var APP_ORIGINS:http://localhost:8788 --var FAMILY_PASSWORD:local-development-only --var SESSION_SECRET:local-development-session-secret-not-for-production
scripts.db:local: wrangler d1 migrations apply kindrd --local --config wrangler.example.jsonc && wrangler d1 execute kindrd --local --config wrangler.example.jsonc --file build/seed.sql
scripts.deploy: npm run build && wrangler deploy --config wrangler.local.jsonc
scripts.db:migrate:remote: wrangler d1 migrations apply kindrd --remote --config wrangler.local.jsonc
scripts.db:seed:remote: wrangler d1 execute kindrd --remote --config wrangler.local.jsonc --file build/seed.sql
